title: When did Lisbon's mayor say Web Summit would probably not open: 13:19 or 13:23?
summary: Our timeline has the mayor's "Tudo indica que a Web Summit não poderá funcionar amanhã" at 13:19; Vicky's weather desk has 13:23; the Jornal Económico article we cite carries a publication time of 13:23:13 in the media watch. All are press times, none is the time he spoke. The lead time to the decision changes by four minutes (5 h 50 min or 5 h 46 min).
